test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is '**Grajual**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Grajual**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Gradual**'.
 
• It means **'happening slowly or over a long period of time; not sudden'.** (मंद गति से लंबी कालावधि में संपन्‍न; एकाएक नहीं, क्रमिक)
 
 
• *Example: There has been a **gradual** change in the climate.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Manual**: using your hands; operated by hand. (जिसमें हाथों का प्रयोग हो; हस्‍त-चालित)
 
• **Mutual**: (used about a feeling or action) felt or done equally by both people involved. [(कोई मनोभाव या क्रिया) दोनों पक्षों द्वारा समान रूप से एक दूसरे के प्रति अनूभूत या संपादित, पारस्‍परिक, आपसी]
 
• **Usual**: happening or used most often. (बहुधा होने या प्रयोग में आने वाला; सामान्य)
